title: Greenbrix C6: 4 investment deals banks pass on
topic: Investment, commercial and land: 4 investment deals banks pass on
hook: 4 investment deals banks pass on. We look at them.
logline: Seven-slide Greenbrix Capital carousel for Krystian Catala: 4 investment deals banks pass on.
structure: 7 slides: four deals on a plinth, rentals with a dashed BANK LIMIT wall, storefront with apartments above, staked land parcel with NOTICE sign, fixer with scaffolding, deal sheet, CTA with Krystian. Slides 2-3 end with a BANK / GREENBRIX strip.
device: architect's massing models drawn as isometric SVG: context buildings in white card, each deal built from Greenbrix bricks (logo gradient with running-bond mortar); cover shows all four deals on one plinth under a giant lime '4'
rejectedStructures: icon tiles on a deal grid (previous attempt, replaced)
lessons: Cover copy changed from 'We fund them' to 'We look at them.' to avoid promising approval.
'You'll get a yes, a no or a number, quickly' is a service promise the client must be comfortable with.
